data.description:
Implement `watchDbChanges` in `packages/herdr/src/db-change.ts` (parent WL-0MV02VA29009WBEN).

## Goal
A cheap, cross-process-safe watch over the worklog change signal so the pane can react to an agent write promptly.

## Scope
- `watchDbChanges(cacheDir, worklogDir, opts)`: watches the state-counter file (`state/<hash>.json`) and/or `worklog.db`/`-wal`, debounces/coalesces bursts, and emits a change callback.
- Fail open: any watch/read error is reported as unavailable so the caller falls back to polling. Never throws into the TUI loop.
- `dispose()`/`close()` for teardown on pane exit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `watchDbChanges` watches the cross-process DB-change signal (state counter and/or SQLite `worklog.db`/`-wal`), debounces events, and emits at most one change callback per burst.
- The watch fails open: any read or `fs.watch` error is reported as unavailable and the caller falls back to the 30 s auto-refresh tick.
- Watch teardown (`dispose`) removes all `fs.watch` handles and timers.
- Unit tests cover the watch trigger, debounce/coalescing, and fail-open fallback, with injected `fs.watch`/clock.

## Implementation notes
- Prefer `node:fs` `watch` (no new runtime dependencies). Handle the state-counter file being absent at start-up (watch the `state/` directory or fall back to polling).
- Inject `fs.watch`/timers for deterministic tests (mirror the `db-change.test.ts` mocking style).

## Dependencies
- F1 verification harness (shared contract tests).
data.title: Event-driven DB-change watch primitive

## Implementation (parent session herdr-1791814520-3149170-2335)

Triaged the three same-named icons test files and documented their legitimately distinct layers; removed the one verbatim duplicate found.

### Triage
| File | Layer | Imports tested |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/unit/icons.test.ts` (208 tests) | CLI icon vocabulary | `src/theme.ts` — a **distinct module** from the shared icons (includes `WL_NO_ICONS` env handling) |
| `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` (48 tests) | herdr display integration | `@worklog/shared/icons` — status/stage/priority/audit/epic/risk/effort/needsProducerReview icons, `stageColor`, general `getIconPrefix` |
| `packages/herdr/src/icons.test.ts` (53 tests) | herdr package unit | `@worklog/shared/icons` `iconsEnabled`, fixed-width agent-slot alignment, `isAuditFresh` rendering |

The three files are **not** duplicates of each other: `tests/unit` exercises a different module, and the two herdr files cover different concerns (display integration vs agent-slot alignment/audit freshness). No other cross-file verbatim duplicates were found (only generic repeated `it` titles within a file).

### Verbatim duplicate removed
`tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` and `packages/herdr/src/icons.test.ts` both contained an **identical** `iconsEnabled` describe block (3 tests, same assertions, same `@worklog/shared/icons` import). Removed it from `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` and dropped the now-unused import; the copy in `packages/herdr/src/icons.test.ts` remains.

### Documentation
- Header layer notes added to all three files cross-referencing each other.
- `tests/README.md` — new 'Icons test layering' section justifying the three files and recording the removed duplicate.

### Coverage accounting
- Removed: 3 duplicated `iconsEnabled` assertions (still covered by `packages/herdr/src/icons.test.ts`).
- All other assertions retained.
- Verified locally: 3 files / 309 tests passed (herdr-root 48 after the removal).
